finalText:
1. Grep (parallel batch, widened to repo root rather than just config/, in case retry_count is referenced in docs or scripts too): search for retry_count across the repo — one parallel block, not sequential, since the searches don't depend on each other.
2. Edit (parallel batch): apply the retry_count -> max_retries replacement to every matched file at once — independent edits, no shared state, so no reason to serialize them.
3. Verification: a single end-state grep for retry_count repo-wide after all edits — zero matches confirms the rename; I wouldn't re-read each edited file individually since the edit tool already errors loudly on a failed apply, and re-reading would just spend context confirming what the tool already confirmed.

No subagent: I already established the repo is small and where configs live, so dispatching a search subagent here would trade a fast, known lookup for slower indirection — the subagent is for when I don't know where things live, not for this.
